description: This file contains the implementation of a template class RangeMap used for managing address ranges and associated entries, including methods for storing, retrieving, and managing ranges within a map structure.

classes.name: RangeMap
classes.description: Template class implementing a range map for address ranges and associated entries.

methods.name: StoreRange
methods.description: Stores a range defined by base address and size with an associated entry, ensuring no overlaps.

methods.name: RetrieveRange
methods.description: Retrieves the entry and range details for a given address if it falls within a stored range.

methods.name: RetrieveNearestRange
methods.description: Retrieves the nearest range to a given address, whether or not the address is within a range.

methods.name: RetrieveRangeAtIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the range and entry at a specific index in the map.

methods.name: GetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of ranges stored in the map.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all ranges from the map.
